content.short: Wada is a community-driven Cardano hub focused on blockchain education and local adoption across Africa.
content.description: Wada is a community organization and regional hub focused on blockchain education, adoption, and local capacity building across Africa. Through Wada Hubs and ecosystem programs, the project supports developers, entrepreneurs, and community members with resources for learning and building on Cardano. It also participates in Project Catalyst and governance conversations so African perspectives are represented in ecosystem growth. Wada's mission is to expand access to decentralized technology through education and local infrastructure.
